# Miji

> Miji is a dictionary that remembers for you. Look up a word, tap Remember, and Miji turns it into flashcards and brings it back — in notifications you answer from your lock screen — until you genuinely know it.

Search once, remember forever.

Miji is an iPhone app (iOS 26 or later). Backed by memory science. Miji's notification-based system makes it hard NOT to memorize words.

## Facts

- iPhone, iOS 26 or later
- English
- 85,000 words, 230,000 senses, 195,000 example sentences
- Works offline
- No account
- Data Not Collected
- Dictionary from Wiktionary and Open English WordNet (CC BY-SA)
